site.name: M/V HONDIUS
site.desc: UNOG confirmed evacuation complete 11 May; all passengers and crew disembarked Tenerife, repatriation underway across 23 nations. WHO reports 8 cases (6 confirmed, 2 additional) and 3 deaths linked to vessel as of 10 May; vessel en route Rotterdam with 30 skeleton crew + Dutch nurse for full decontamination.
